products.Product: THE FARRAH LONG SLEEVE MAILLOT in BLACK NEOPRENE
products.Official Description:
The Relaunch of the LMF Signature Neoprene Collection

 

Since its debut in 2010, the Farrah Long Sleeve Maillot has been our iconic Bond Girl-inspired one-piece and most popular. Designed for water sports like surfing, paddleboarding, or waterskiing, it features intricate zig-zag stitching that contours the body for a sleek, sexy fit. The adjustable zipper lets you customize the look, whether sexy or sporty . Versatile enough to go from water adventures to après-sport style, the Farrah also works as a bodysuit, transitioning effortlessly from day to night.

 

Shown here in Black Neoprene. Fabrication: 1.0 mm Neoprene: Exterior: 84% Nylon, 16% Elastane. Interior: 100% Chloroprene.

 

Model is wearing Size 2.

 

Made in the U.S.A.

products.Product: THE JASMINE BIKINI in NAVY NEOPRENE
products.Official Description:
The Relaunch of the LMF Signature Neoprene Collection

 

A beloved cult classic since its debut in 2009, The Jasmine Bikini continues to redefine modern swimwear. This sexy tank bikini blends sporty sophistication with chic details, featuring intricate zig-zag stitching that contours the body for a sleek, flattering fit and our signature, adjustable scuba-inspired zipper. The new high-leg bikini bottoms create an elongated silhouette, offering just the right balance of allure and coverage. Wear it on the beach or style it as a versatile ready-to-wear top—The Jasmine Bikini transitions effortlessly from swimwear to everyday fashion.

 

Crafted from our new, luxurious 1.0mm Neoprene, the fabric strikes the perfect balance—thinner and soft like traditional swimwear, yet maintaining the sculpting properties that make the body look great. 

 

Shown here in Navy Neoprene. Fabrication: 1.0 mm Neoprene: Exterior: 84% Nylon, 16% Elastane. Interior: 100% Chloroprene.

 

Model is wearing Size 2.

 

Made in the U.S.A.

products.Product: THE KRISTI BIKINI in NAVY NEOPRENE

Debuting in 2009, the Genevieve Zip High-Waist Bikini has returned and remains a beloved favorite.
